caption: The drawing depicts an object comprised of two main metal components facing each other and joined at the top by a horizontal bar. Both components are similarly shaped with rounded tops forming loops, which are connected to the bar. The bar is secured in the center by a vertical piece that appears to have serrated, gear-like orange-brown details. The left component has a mostly dark metallic, iron-like appearance with a simpler, circular disk in the center and an intricately curved lower section ending in a trefoil shape. The right component is more decorative, featuring an oval silver-colored plate decorated with fine etching and a central compass-like marking. This component also has a similarly curved lower section, ending in a trefoil shape matching the left. The background is a plain off-white color with no additional objects or details, and the names "Raymond E. Noble" and "Harry W. Windell" are written in the lower right corner.
